content:
All Out was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW). It took place on September 5, 2021 at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois.

The main event was a five-way match for the AEW World Championship, which was won by Kenny Omega, who retained the title. Other notable matches included:

- CM Punk vs. Darby Allin
- The Young Bucks (Matt Jackson and Nick Jackson) vs. Lucha Brothers (Penta El Zero Miedo and Rey Fénix) for the AEW World Tag Team Championship
- Dr. Britt Baker, D.M.D. vs. Kris Statlander for the AEW Women's World Championship

The event marked CM Punk's return to professional wrestling after a 7-year absence. It was also the first AEW pay-per-view to feature a sold-out arena since the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic.

Overall, All Out 2021 was well-received by fans and critics as a strong pay-per-view event that showcased AEW's growing roster of talent. It helped build momentum for the company heading into the rest of the year.
